intro.en: Kabir, 14, is in a class WhatsApp group where some boys have started sharing adult clips. Tonight the pressure lands on him. Choose what Kabir does.
intro.hg: 14 saal ka Kabir class ke ek WhatsApp group mein hai jahan kuch ladkon ne adult clips share karna shuru kar diya hai. Aaj raat pressure usi pe aa gaya hai. Chuno ki Kabir kya karta hai.

text.en: Arnav posts a link and writes, 'Kabir is the only baby here who hasn't watched this. Open it now and prove you're not scared.' Others add laughing emojis.
text.hg: Arnav ek link daalta hai aur likhta hai, 'Yahan Kabir hi akela bachcha hai jisne yeh nahi dekha. Abhi khol aur prove kar ki tu darta nahi.' Baaki log hansne wale emojis bhejte hain.

label.en: Reply 'Not my thing, send match highlights' and don't open it
label.hg: Reply karna 'Not my thing, match highlights bhej' aur link na kholna

feedback.en: A short, calm no works. You do not owe the group proof of anything, and teasing usually fades when it gets no reaction. Choosing not to watch is completely normal.
feedback.hg: Chhoti, calm na kaam karti hai. Tumhe group ko kuch bhi prove karne ki zaroorat nahi hai, aur jab reaction nahi milta toh chidhana aksar thanda pad jaata hai. Na dekhne ka decision poori tarah normal hai.

label.en: Say nothing and mute the group for the night
label.hg: Kuch na bolna aur raat bhar ke liye group mute kar dena

feedback.en: Muting protects you tonight, and that is fine. The pressure may return tomorrow, though, so having one calm line ready helps you say no without a fight.
feedback.hg: Mute karne se aaj raat tum bach jaate ho, aur yeh theek hai. Lekin pressure kal phir laut sakta hai, isliye ek calm line ready rakhna bina jhagde ke na bolne mein help karta hai.

label.en: Open it so that they stop teasing
label.hg: Link khol lena taaki woh chidhana band kar dein

feedback.en: Wanting the teasing to stop is understandable. But watching under pressure hands the group control over your choices, and the clip is scripted adult content, not real life. You can still say no next time.
feedback.hg: Chidhana band ho, yeh chahna samajh aata hai. Lekin pressure mein dekhne se tumhare decisions ka control group ke haath mein chala jaata hai, aur woh clip scripted adult content hai, real life nahi. Agli baar tum ab bhi na bol sakte ho.

text.en: Next day at lunch Arnav says, 'See, that's how it works. Girls say no but they actually want it. You don't need to ask.'
text.hg: Agle din lunch mein Arnav kehta hai, 'Dekha, aise hi hota hai. Ladkiyan na bolti hain par actually chahti hain. Puchne ki zaroorat hi nahi.'

label.en: Say, 'That's acting from a script. In real life no means no.'
label.hg: Bolna, 'Woh script wali acting hai. Real life mein na ka matlab na hai.'

feedback.en: Exactly. Porn turns refusals into a yes because a script says so. In real life, ignoring a no is pressure or assault. Saying this aloud also helps friends who were quietly doubting it.
feedback.hg: Bilkul. Porn mana karne ko haan mein isliye badal deta hai kyunki script mein aisa likha hai. Real life mein na ko ignore karna pressure ya assault hai. Yeh baat khulke bolne se un doston ko bhi help milti hai jinhe andar se is pe doubt tha.

label.en: Stay quiet and change the topic
label.hg: Chup rehna aur topic change kar dena

feedback.en: Avoiding an argument is understandable, and you did not agree with him. Still, silence lets a harmful idea go unchallenged. Even 'I don't think that's true' makes a difference.
feedback.hg: Argument se bachna samajh aata hai, aur tumne uski haan mein haan nahi milayi. Phir bhi chuppi ek harmful idea ko bina toke chalne deti hai. Sirf 'Mujhe nahi lagta yeh sach hai' bolna bhi fark daalta hai.

label.en: Laugh and agree so that you fit in
label.hg: Hans ke haan bol dena taaki group mein fit ho jao

feedback.en: Fitting in matters at 14, so this is a common reaction. But agreeing spreads the idea that a no can be ignored, and that belief leads to real harm. You can disagree lightly and still keep your friends.
feedback.hg: 14 ki age mein fit hona matter karta hai, isliye yeh common reaction hai. Lekin haan bolne se yeh idea failta hai ki na ko ignore kiya ja sakta hai, aur yahi soch real harm tak le jaati hai. Tum halke andaaz mein disagree karke bhi apne dost rakh sakte ho.

text.en: That evening someone posts an AI-edited sexual photo using the face of Meher, a girl from the class. The group explodes with comments.
text.hg: Usi shaam koi group mein AI se edit ki hui ek sexual photo daalta hai jisme class ki ek ladki Meher ka chehra lagaya gaya hai. Group mein comments ki baadh aa jaati hai.

label.en: Don't forward or save it, tell the group to stop, and tell a trusted adult or teacher
label.hg: Use forward ya save na karna, group ko bolna band karo, aur kisi trusted adult ya teacher ko batana

feedback.en: This is the response that protects Meher. A fake sexual image of someone under 18 is abuse and a serious offence to create or share. Not forwarding, speaking up and involving an adult gets it stopped and reported properly.
feedback.hg: Yahi response Meher ko protect karta hai. 18 se kam umar ke kisi insaan ki fake sexual image abuse hai, aur use banana ya share karna serious offence hai. Forward na karna, bolna aur kisi adult ko involve karna ise rukwata hai aur theek se report karwata hai.

feedback.en: Leaving keeps you out of it, but the image keeps spreading and Meher still does not know. You have done nothing wrong; adding one more step, telling a trusted adult, is what actually helps her.
feedback.hg: Group chhodne se tum isse bahar rehte ho, lekin image failti rehti hai aur Meher ko ab bhi pata nahi. Tumne kuch galat nahi kiya; bas ek step aur, kisi trusted adult ko batana, yahi sach mein uski help karta hai.

label.en: Forward it to one close friend to show how bad it is
label.hg: Ek close friend ko forward karna, yeh dikhane ke liye ki yeh kitna bura hai

feedback.en: The intention may be to show concern, but every forward creates another copy and can itself be an offence. The safer path is to not share it at all and tell a trusted adult.
feedback.hg: Intention concern dikhane ka ho sakta hai, lekin har forward ek aur copy banata hai aur khud offence ho sakta hai. Safe raasta yeh hai ki ise bilkul share na karo aur kisi trusted adult ko batao.

debrief.en: Porn is scripted adult media, and you never need to watch it to belong. Its biggest lie is that a no can be ignored. And when a real or fake intimate image of someone appears, the rule is simple: do not forward, do not save, speak up and tell a trusted adult so that it can be reported.
debrief.hg: Porn adults ke liye bana scripted media hai, aur group ka hissa banne ke liye use dekhna kabhi zaroori nahi. Uska sabse bada jhooth yeh hai ki na ko ignore kiya ja sakta hai. Aur jab kisi ki real ya fake intimate image saamne aaye, toh rule simple hai: forward mat karo, save mat karo, bolo aur kisi trusted adult ko batao taaki report ho sake.

intro.en: Dev, 17, has been chatting for a week with 'Tanya', who followed him on Instagram. Her profile is new, her photos look like a model's, and tonight the chat changes. Choose what Dev does.
intro.hg: 17 saal ka Dev ek hafte se 'Tanya' se chat kar raha hai, jisne use Instagram pe follow kiya tha. Uski profile nayi hai, photos kisi model jaisi hain, aur aaj raat chat ka rukh badal jaata hai. Chuno ki Dev kya karta hai.

text.en: Tanya writes, 'Let's move to a video call on another app. I'll show you something special if you do the same. Don't be boring.'
text.hg: Tanya likhti hai, 'Chalo kisi dusre app pe video call karte hain. Agar tum bhi waisa karo toh main tumhe kuch special dikhaungi. Boring mat bano.'

label.en: Decline, keep the chat where it is, and check her profile for signs of a fake account
label.hg: Mana karna, chat wahin rakhna, aur uski profile mein fake account ke signs check karna

feedback.en: Good instinct. A new profile, model-like photos, fast intimacy and a push to another app are classic warning signs. Slowing down and checking costs you nothing if the person is genuine.
feedback.hg: Achhi instinct. Nayi profile, model jaisi photos, fast closeness aur dusre app pe chalne ka push, yeh sab classic warning signs hain. Agar saamne wala genuine hai, toh slow karne aur check karne mein tumhara kuch nahi jaata.

label.en: Join the call but decide to keep it 'normal'
label.hg: Call join kar lena, par decide karna ki sab 'normal' hi rakhna hai

feedback.en: Staying clothed lowers the risk, but calls can be screen-recorded and your face can be edited onto fake images. With someone you have never met and cannot verify, skipping the private call is safer.
feedback.hg: Kapdon mein rehne se risk kam hota hai, lekin call screen-record ho sakti hai aur tumhara chehra fake images pe lagaya ja sakta hai. Jisse tum kabhi mile nahi aur jise verify nahi kar sakte, uske saath private call skip karna hi zyada safe hai.

label.en: Go along with what she asks
label.hg: Jo woh bol rahi hai, waisa kar lena

feedback.en: Many people of all genders get drawn in this way; scammers are skilled at building trust fast. But anything shown on camera can be recorded and used for blackmail. If this happens, it is still not too late to get help.
feedback.hg: Har gender ke bahut log isi tarah phans jaate hain; scammers jaldi trust banane mein expert hote hain. Lekin camera pe dikhayi gayi koi bhi cheez record hoke blackmail mein use ho sakti hai. Agar aisa ho bhi jaaye, tab bhi help lene mein der nahi hui hoti.

text.en: An hour later a new message arrives: 'I have a video with your face. Send ₹5,000 by UPI in 30 minutes or it goes to your followers and family.' A list of his followers is attached.
text.hg: Ek ghante baad naya message aata hai: 'Mere paas tumhare chehre wala video hai. 30 minute mein UPI se ₹5,000 bhejo, warna yeh tumhare followers aur family ko jaayega.' Saath mein uske followers ki list lagi hai.

label.en: Stop replying, don't pay, and leave the chat undeleted
label.hg: Reply band karna, paise na dena, aur chat delete na karna

feedback.en: Right. Blackmailers rely on panic and countdowns. Paying usually brings more demands, and the chat, username and UPI ID are what the police need. Staying silent with the scammer and keeping the evidence is the strongest move.
feedback.hg: Sahi. Blackmailers panic aur countdowns pe tike hote hain. Paise dene se aksar demands aur badhti hain, aur police ko chat, username aur UPI ID ki hi zaroorat hoti hai. Scammer ko reply na karna aur evidence bacha ke rakhna sabse strong move hai.

label.en: Delete the account and every chat in panic
label.hg: Panic mein account aur saari chats delete kar dena

feedback.en: The urge to make it disappear is natural. But deleting removes the evidence needed to trace the account and does not remove the scammer's copy. Keep the chat, and instead tighten privacy settings and report.
feedback.hg: Sab kuch gayab kar dene ki urge natural hai. Lekin delete karne se woh evidence mit jaata hai jisse account trace ho sakta hai, aur scammer ke paas ki copy nahi mitti. Chat rehne do, aur uski jagah privacy settings tight karo aur report karo.

label.en: Pay once and hope it ends
label.hg: Ek baar paise de dena aur hope karna ki baat khatam ho jaayegi

feedback.en: Wanting it to end quickly makes complete sense. But payment tells the blackmailer that pressure works, and demands typically grow. If you have already paid, stop now and report; you can still get help.
feedback.hg: Yeh chahna ki sab jaldi khatam ho jaaye, poori tarah samajh aata hai. Lekin paise dene se blackmailer ko pata chalta hai ki pressure kaam karta hai, aur demands aksar badhti jaati hain. Agar tum paise de chuke ho, toh ab ruk jao aur report karo; help ab bhi mil sakti hai.

text.en: Dev is shaking. He knows he should tell someone, but he is scared of what his parents will say.
text.hg: Dev kaanp raha hai. Use pata hai ki kisi ko batana chahiye, lekin use dar hai ki mummy-papa kya bolenge.

label.en: Tell a parent or another trusted adult tonight and report together at cybercrime.gov.in or 1930
label.hg: Aaj raat hi parent ya kisi aur trusted adult ko batana aur saath mein cybercrime.gov.in ya 1930 pe report karna

feedback.en: This is the step that takes away the blackmailer's power. Adults may be upset at first, but the threat weakens once it is no longer a secret. Reporting on the portal, on 1930 or at a police station, and on the platform, starts real action.
feedback.hg: Yahi step blackmailer ki power chheen leta hai. Adults shuru mein upset ho sakte hain, lekin jaise hi baat secret nahi rehti, dhamki kamzor pad jaati hai. Portal pe, 1930 pe ya police station mein, aur platform pe report karne se real action shuru hota hai.

label.en: Tell only a close friend and wait to see what happens
label.hg: Sirf ek close friend ko batana aur dekhna ki aage kya hota hai

feedback.en: Telling a friend breaks the isolation, which matters. But friends cannot file a report or deal with police and platforms. Ask the friend to come with you while you tell an adult; under 18, 1098 can also guide you.
feedback.hg: Dost ko batane se akelapan toot-ta hai, aur yeh matter karta hai. Lekin dost report file nahi kar sakte aur na police ya platforms se deal kar sakte hain. Dost ko bolo ki jab tum kisi adult ko batao toh woh saath chale; 18 se kam umar mein 1098 bhi guide kar sakta hai.

label.en: Threaten the scammer back and argue
label.hg: Scammer ko ulta dhamkana aur usse behas karna

feedback.en: Anger at being targeted is fair. But engaging keeps you in the blackmailer's game and can escalate the threats. Silence towards them, plus a report to cybercrime authorities with an adult's support, works better.
feedback.hg: Target banaye jaane pe gussa aana fair hai. Lekin engage karne se tum blackmailer ke game mein bane rehte ho aur dhamkiyan badh sakti hain. Use reply na karna, aur kisi adult ke saath cybercrime authorities ko report karna better kaam karta hai.

debrief.en: Sextortion follows a script: fast intimacy, a move to a private app, then threats with a countdown. The counter-script: stop replying, do not pay, do not send more, keep the chat and account details, tell a trusted adult, and report at cybercrime.gov.in, 1930 or the police. Being tricked is not a crime. If the fear feels unbearable or you think of hurting yourself, call Tele-MANAS 14416 or 112 now.
debrief.hg: Sextortion ek fixed script pe chalta hai: fast closeness, private app pe le jaana, phir countdown wali dhamkiyan. Iska counter-script: reply band karo, paise mat do, aur kuch mat bhejo, chat aur account details sambhal ke rakho, trusted adult ko batao, aur cybercrime.gov.in, 1930 ya police mein report karo. Dhokha kha jaana crime nahi hai. Agar dar bardaasht se bahar lage ya khud ko hurt karne ke khayal aayein, toh abhi Tele-MANAS 14416 ya 112 pe call karo.
